name: WOD Wiki Agent Surface
description: Tri-surface agent capabilities for WOD Wiki across Browser WebMCP, HTTP/Stdio MCP Server, and local CLI.

domainTools.name: wod_parse_script
domainTools.title: Parse Whiteboard Script
domainTools.description: Validate Whiteboard Script syntax, inspect parsed statements, typed metrics, unresolved choices, and collectible `?` placeholders. Defaults to dry-run (`save: false`); pass `save: true` to persist as a Note.

source.description: Whiteboard Script body OR full Markdown document containing ```time / ```wod blocks.

save.description: Default false (dry-run syntax & metric inspection). Set true to persist as a Note.

noteId.description: Optional target Note ID when save=true.

notebookId.description: Optional user Notebook slug/ID when save=true.

domainTools.name: wod_query_wql
domainTools.title: Execute WQL Query
domainTools.description: Run any WQL find (`:note`, `:session`, `:effort`, `:equipment`, `:tag`, `:feed`, `:block`), aggregate (`sum:volume`, `max:weight`, `count:sessions`), or pipeline query against the active WOD Wiki storage.

limit.description: Maximum rows/items to return in the response payload (default 100).

domainTools.name: wod_validate_wql
domainTools.title: Validate & Inspect WQL Query
domainTools.description: Parse a WQL string without executing it. Returns syntax validity, query family (find, aggregate, pipeline), normalized WQL string, and the allowed filter keys and `by {}` grouping dimensions for that plane.

query.description: WQL query string to validate and inspect (e.g. ":note{notebook:journal} last 7d" or "sum:volume by {effort}").

targetHint.description: Optional target plane to list valid filter keys & grouping dimensions for (note, session, effort, equipment, tag, feed, block, event).

domainTools.name: wod_note_list
domainTools.title: List Notes
domainTools.description: List workout and reference Notes with optional filtering by Notebook, search query, tag, and origin.

notebookId.description: Filter by notebook ID or slug (e.g. "journal", "custom", "guides", "notebook/strength").

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over title and Markdown content.

tag.description: Filter to Notes carrying this tag label.

includeSeed.description: Include read-only Seed/Feed notes (default true when notebookId is specified, false otherwise).

domainTools.name: wod_note_get
domainTools.title: Get Note Details
domainTools.description: Read a full Note by ID including authored Markdown, `sourceRevision`, parsed workout blocks, attached Session count, upstream provenance, and publication visibility.

noteId.description: Unique Note ID (UUID or seed route ID).

domainTools.name: wod_note_upsert
domainTools.title: Create or Update Note
domainTools.description: Create a new workout/reference Note or update an existing editable Note with full block-revision pinning, effort/equipment indexing, and optimistic concurrency (`expectedSourceRevision`).

noteId.description: Existing Note ID to update, or omit to create a new Note.

title.description: Note title (defaults to # H1 heading in content).

content.description: Full Markdown document or Whiteboard Script body.

sport.description: Optional sport fence tag when passing bare Whiteboard Script.

expectedSourceRevision.description: Optimistic concurrency guard: pass the current sourceRevision from wod_note_get when updating.

notebookId.description: Optional user Notebook ID/slug to link this Note into (always stays anchored in notebook/journal).

journalDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD or "today" to place the Note on that Journal calendar day.

domainTools.name: wod_note_clone
domainTools.title: Clone Note with Provenance
domainTools.description: Clone any Note (especially read-only Seed or Feed workouts) into a writable user Notebook or Journal day while recording structured upstream `NoteProvenance`.

sourceNoteId.description: Source Note ID (including read-only Seed/Feed Notes) to clone.

targetNotebookId.description: Target writable user Notebook ID/slug (defaults to "notebook/journal").

title.description: Optional title override for the cloned Note.

journalDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD or "today" to pin the clone onto a Journal day.

domainTools.name: wod_note_delete
domainTools.title: Delete Note
domainTools.description: Permanently delete a Note and detach its projections, tag links, and calendar placements (Tier 2 destructive — requires user confirmation or matching confirmId).

noteId.description: ID of the Note to delete.

confirmId.description: For non-interactive MCP/CLI calls, repeat the exact noteId to confirm deletion.

domainTools.name: wod_journal_day
domainTools.title: Get Journal Day
domainTools.description: Fetch all scheduled/authored workout Notes and recorded Sessions for a specific Journal calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `today`).

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or "today" (defaults to "today").

domainTools.name: wod_journal_add
domainTools.title: Add Workout to Journal Day
domainTools.description: Create a new workout Note in `notebook/journal` and place it onto the specified calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `today`).

date.description: Target Journal date in YYYY-MM-DD format or "today" (defaults to "today").

title.description: Workout title (defaults to # H1 heading or date).

content.description: Markdown workout note or bare Whiteboard Script to schedule onto the Journal day.

sport.description: Optional sport fence tag when passing bare Whiteboard Script.

notebookId.description: Optional additional user Notebook to promote this Journal Note into.

domainTools.name: wod_notebook_list
domainTools.title: List Notebooks
domainTools.description: List built-in, user-created, and feed-subscribed Notebooks along with member Note counts and publication status.

domainTools.name: wod_notebook_save
domainTools.title: Create, Update, or Promote Notebook
domainTools.description: Create or update a user-owned Notebook, promote/detach a Note across Notebooks (`notebook/journal` permanence preserved), or toggle Notebook publication visibility.

action.description: Operation to perform on a user Notebook.

notebookId.description: Target Notebook slug or ID (required for update, promote, detach, set-public).

name.description: Display name when creating or renaming a Notebook.

noteId.description: Note ID to promote into or detach from the Notebook.

sessionIds.description: Optional Session IDs on `noteId` to promote alongside the Note.

public.description: Visibility flag when action="set-public" or promoting sessions.

domainTools.name: wod_notebook_delete
domainTools.title: Delete User Notebook
domainTools.description: Delete a user-created Notebook landing note and detach member links while keeping all member Notes safely in `notebook/journal` (Tier 2 destructive).

notebookId.description: User Notebook ID or slug to delete (member Notes stay safe in notebook/journal).

confirmId.description: For non-interactive MCP/CLI calls, repeat the exact notebookId or slug to confirm deletion.

domainTools.name: wod_session_run_headless
domainTools.title: Run Workout Session Headlessly
domainTools.description: Execute a workout block through the headless JIT compiler and runtime state machine, recording a pinned `Session` and derived `EventRecord`s in storage. Automatically clones read-only Seed/Feed Notes into `notebook/journal`.

noteId.description: Existing Note ID to execute (read-only Seed/Feed Notes are automatically cloned to notebook/journal).

blockId.description: Optional workout block ID on `noteId` (defaults to first wod block).

source.description: Inline Whiteboard Script or Markdown to persist & run when `noteId` is not supplied.

title.description: Optional Note title when running inline `source`.

journalDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD or "today" Journal calendar date.

stepAdvanceMs.description: Simulated clock advance per step in milliseconds (default 10000).

public.description: Mark the recorded Session public for Feed publication.

domainTools.name: wod_session_list
domainTools.title: List Recorded Sessions
domainTools.description: List recorded workout Sessions ordered newest-first, optionally filtered by Note ID.

noteId.description: Filter Sessions by owning Note ID.

domainTools.name: wod_session_get
domainTools.title: Get Session Telemetry
domainTools.description: Read a recorded workout Session along with its pinned `BlockRevision` and derived event/summary telemetry rows.

domainTools.name: wod_session_delete
domainTools.title: Delete Recorded Session
domainTools.description: Permanently delete a recorded workout Session and its telemetry events (Tier 2 destructive — requires confirmation).

confirmId.description: For non-interactive MCP/CLI calls, repeat the exact sessionId to confirm deletion.

domainTools.name: wod_catalog_lookup
domainTools.title: Lookup Efforts, Equipment & Tags
domainTools.description: Search or inspect the Effort movement registry, Equipment catalog, Tags, and Tag Categories with Notebook-scoped override precedence (`notebook/defaults` -> Feed/Notebook -> `notebook/custom`).

kind.description: Catalog family to search or inspect.

search.description: Case-insensitive slug, label, or alias filter.

slug.description: Exact canonical slug/name to look up.

notebookId.description: Optional Notebook scope for property inheritance resolution.

domainTools.name: wod_catalog_upsert
domainTools.title: Save Effort, Equipment, or Tag Property Note
domainTools.description: Create or update a Scoped Property Override (`effort`, `equipment`, `tag`, or `tag-type`) in `notebook/custom` or a shared user Notebook.

kind.description: Property definition family to create or override.

targetNotebookId.description: Target Notebook scope: defaults to "notebook/custom" (personal runtime) or a writable user Notebook.

markdown.description: Full Property Note Markdown with YAML frontmatter. If omitted, synthesized from structured fields below.

domainTools.name: wod_feed_manage
domainTools.title: Manage Feeds & Portability
domainTools.description: Inspect installed Seed/Feed sources (`list`), check unpublished public Notebook changes (`status`), compile and publish public Notebooks (`publish`), or import portable Markdown + JSONL/CSV files (`import-bundle`).

action.description: Feed or portability operation to run.

notebookSlug.description: Optional Notebook slug filter when publishing.

name.description: Optional Feed display name when publishing.

domainTools.name: wod_export_bundle
domainTools.title: Export Portable Markdown & Telemetry Bundle
domainTools.description: Export user Notes and attached Session telemetry directly as structured `{ path, content }` strings (Markdown + JSONL/CSV) without triggering synthetic browser file downloads.

noteIds.description: Optional Note IDs to export (defaults to all user-owned Notes).

telemetryFormat.description: Format for companion Session/Event telemetry files (default "jsonl").

domainTools.name: wod_reset_storage
domainTools.title: Wipe Storage Data
domainTools.description: Wipe user Notes, Sessions, Events, and Notebook data from the active storage backend (Tier 2 destructive — requires explicit user confirmation).

confirmToken.description: For non-interactive MCP/CLI calls, pass confirmToken="WIPE_STORAGE" to confirm wiping user storage.

uiTools.name: ui_get_view_context
uiTools.title: Get Active UI View Context
uiTools.description: Read the current browser route, hydration/loading state, unbatched stream results, active editor metadata, and live workout clock snapshot.

includeSampleEntries.description: Include up to 50 unbatched stream entries when on a stream route (default true).

uiTools.name: ui_navigate
uiTools.title: Navigate Playground Route
uiTools.description: Navigate the React Router SPA to any WOD Wiki route (`/journal`, `/day/:date`, `/note/:id`, `/notebooks`, `/dashboards`, `/run/:id?note=:noteId`) and wait for UI commit.

path.description: Internal app path (with optional ?query and #hash) to navigate to, e.g. "/journal", "/day/2026-11-11", "/note/<id>", "/notebooks", "/dashboards".

replace.description: Replace current history entry instead of pushing.

uiTools.name: ui_cast_control
uiTools.title: Inspect or Disconnect Cast Session
uiTools.description: Check active Chromecast / receiver display session state or cleanly disconnect an active Cast session.

action.description: Inspect active Chromecast/receiver session status or disconnect an active session.

uiTools.name: ui_set_stream_query
uiTools.title: Set Live Stream WQL Query or Layout
uiTools.description: Update the live WQL query, layout (`cards`, `rows`, `feed`, `agenda`, `planner`), or grouping on the currently mounted stream view, or reset to the route default.

query.description: WQL query string to apply to the mounted stream view (e.g. ":note{tags:benchmark}").

layout.description: Switch stream layout mode and sync ?layout= in URL.

groupBy.description: Grouping dimension (e.g. "date", "week", "notebook") or null to clear.

resetToDefault.description: Undo custom stream filter and restore the route default WQL query.

uiTools.name: ui_editor_draft
uiTools.title: Read, Edit, or Undo Live Note Editor Buffer
uiTools.description: Inspect or edit the live CodeMirror 6 Note buffer (`read`, `replace`, `append`, `undo`) with full undo history and optional immediate persistence.
uiTools.mountScope: mounted Note / Journal / Playground editor surfaces

operation.description: Read live editor buffer, replace document content, append Markdown/workout block, or undo last edit.

content.description: Markdown or Whiteboard Script content for replace / append operations.

save.description: Flush and persist the draft to storage immediately after applying the edit (default false).

uiTools.name: ui_start_live_workout
uiTools.title: Start Live Interactive Workout Timer
uiTools.description: Launch the live interactive workout clock on screen from a workout block in the active Note editor so the human athlete and agent can co-drive the session.
uiTools.mountScope: mounted Note / Journal / Playground editor surfaces

blockId.description: Optional workout block ID in the active Note editor (defaults to first ```time block).

autoStart.description: Automatically start the timer after mounting the workout clock (default true).

uiTools.name: ui_clock_control
uiTools.title: Control Live Workout Clock
uiTools.description: Dispatch commands (`next`, `playback`, `ready-start`, `entry-save`, `reps-set`, `stop-request`, `stop-confirm`, `dismiss`, etc.) to the active on-screen workout clock and return the updated ClockSnapshot.

command.description: Live workout clock command to dispatch (or "status" to read current ClockSnapshot).

fieldId.description: Target fieldId for entry-save, entry-skip, or choice-select.

value.description: Numeric value for entry-save or reps-set.

occurrenceId.description: Rep occurrenceId for reps-adjust, reps-set, or reps-select.

uiTools.name: ui_preferences
uiTools.title: Get or Set Playground UI Preferences
uiTools.description: Read or update global Playground UI preferences (`theme`, `audioEnabled`, `debugMode`, `analyticsUnit`, and mobile navigation drawers).

action.description: Read current Playground UI preferences ("get") or update preferences ("set").

audioEnabled.description: Enable or mute workout timer audio cues.

debugMode.description: Enable or disable global runtime debug mode.

analyticsUnit.description: Preferred display unit for analytics charts (`kg` or `lb`).

leftDrawerOpen.description: Open or close the primary navigation drawer on mobile/tablet.

rightDrawerOpen.description: Open or close the secondary L3 context drawer on mobile/tablet.

uiTools.name: ui_set_explorer_query
uiTools.title: Set or Run Analytics Explorer WQL Query
uiTools.description: Set or execute an aggregate or find WQL query on the Metric Explorer (`/dashboards`), change the week window (`4`, `8`, `16`), or open the Save-to-Dashboard / Query Settings dialogs.

query.description: WQL aggregate or find query string to set on the Metric Explorer (`/dashboards`), e.g. "sum:totalVolume{} by {week}".

submit.description: Execute/submit the query immediately (default true when `query` is provided).

weeks.description: Analytics lookback range in weeks (`4`, `8`, or `16`).

openSaveDialog.description: Open the "Save to dashboard" dialog for the active query.

openQuerySettings.description: Open the surface query settings dialog on `/dashboards`.

resources.name: Whiteboard Language Reference
resources.description: Compact syntax, metric token, and fence-tag guide for authoring Whiteboard Language workouts.

resources.name: WQL Grammar & Capabilities
resources.description: Machine-readable WQL targets, aggregators, filter keys, metric families, and examples.

resources.name: Notebooks Snapshot
resources.description: Current local and subscribed feed notebooks with member counts.

resources.name: Workout Note by ID
resources.description: Full Markdown source, block map, tags, and recent sessions for a Note.

resources.name: Journal Day Stream
resources.description: Scheduled notes and logged sessions for YYYY-MM-DD or today.

resources.name: Workout Session Detail
resources.description: Session record and full segment/summary event ledger.

prompts.name: encode-workout
prompts.title: Encode Plain-Text Workout into Whiteboard Language
prompts.description: Convert unstructured workout text into valid ```wod Markdown and verify with wod_parse_script.

arguments.name: workoutText
arguments.description: Plain-text description of the workout to encode.

arguments.name: sport
arguments.description: Optional sport dialect (e.g. crossfit, running, weightlifting).

prompts.name: analyze-training-load
prompts.title: Analyze Recent Training Load via WQL
prompts.description: Inspect recent sessions, volume rollups, and movement balance over a date window.

arguments.name: window
arguments.description: Relative WQL window such as 7d, 30d, or 90d (defaults to 30d).

prompts.name: program-journal-day
prompts.title: Program a Training Day on the Journal
prompts.description: Review recent training history, avoid movement interference, and schedule a workout on a date.

arguments.name: date
arguments.description: Target civil date YYYY-MM-DD or today.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Training focus, time cap, or equipment constraints.
